title: Northside Coffee: our story so far

scenes.title: Our story so far
scenes.subtitle: Northside Coffee · sample data
scenes.narration: Five years ago, Northside Coffee was one counter and a second-hand espresso machine.

scenes.heading: From one counter to three shops

events.label: Oat milk at no extra cost

scenes.narration: We opened on Mill Street in twenty twenty-one. A year later we started roasting our own beans. Then came a second shop by the station, oat milk at no extra cost, and last year a digital loyalty card.

scenes.heading: Where our beans come from
scenes.narration: Our beans come from three farms we know by name, in Colombia, Ethiopia and Brazil. Every sack comes to London, where we roast it ourselves.

scenes.heading: What's next
scenes.narration: This year, the new roastery opened, and you can now order ahead in the app. Our third shop, at Riverside, is being built right now. Next year, weekend cupping classes.

scenes.title: Thanks for every cup
scenes.narration: Thank you for every cup. See you at Riverside.
